decisions.rationale: Field was never cleared on mailbox close. canPop = _isReadyToReceive ? false : (_handshakeDocId == null) stayed false because _handshakeDocId persisted. Back-nav permanently blocked after any connection.

decisions.decision: _lastConnectedSender field in ReceiverScreen survives close/reopen cycle
decisions.rationale: Not included in close setState wipe. Set after handshake completes. On reopen, if no pre-fill, fires _onSenderSelected automatically — new RSA key already in Firestore at that point.

decisions.decision: _everConnected flag in SenderScreen to detect reconnect vs first connect
decisions.rationale: _everConnected=true AND _selectedReceiverPublicKeyJson==null when new doc arrives = reconnect. Shows green snackbar 'Connection re-established with new RSA key'.

decisions.decision: _emitIfResolved enriches raw Firestore status with direction
decisions.rationale: outSnap exists = I sent it → pending_sent. inSnap exists = they sent it → pending_received. Either connected → accepted. _buildTrailing was checking for these strings but emitIfResolved was passing raw 'pending'/'connected', so all tiles showed Connect button regardless of actual state.

decisions.decision: FindFriendsScreen white-screen root cause: BackdropFilter in OverlayEntry + silent stream errors
decisions.rationale: GlassContainer.blur=24 in _ProposalBanner OverlayEntry. Impeller backend may not clean up compositor on entry.remove(), leaving screen frozen. Secondary: onError:(_){} in _subscribeConnections kills the stream silently — _connectedUsers never updates after accept, page stuck in empty state permanently.
